Designed for Every Device

Seamless computer vision inference across phones, tablets, laptops, and desktops.

🤖

Deep Learning Accuracy

Powered by a singleton TensorFlow/Keras neural network with OpenCV & Pillow preprocessing for calibrated top-K predictions.

📸

Instant Camera Capture

Capture photos directly from your mobile or laptop camera in the browser or pick from your photo gallery with a single tap.

⚡

Fast & Lightweight

Zero browser ML bloat. All heavy TensorFlow inference runs on the Django backend so mobile devices stay fast and responsive.

🛡️

Secure & Private

Strict MIME validation, Pillow header verification, CSRF protection, file size enforcement, and randomized safe filenames.

Dynamically loaded from ml/class_names.json (15 active categories).
